ui.panel.lovelace.editor.card.map.basema: Where the map imagery comes from. Auto uses Tianditu when a key is set. Domestic providers replace the OSM base map with raster tiles; markers, zones and trails are unaffected.
Free key from console.tianditu.gov.cn. Required by both Tianditu providers.
XYZ template with {z}, {x} and {y}, e.g. https://tiles.example.com/{z}/{x}/{y}.png. Only used by the Custom provider.
Copyright line shown on the map. Required by most tile providers.
Beyond this level the last tiles are scaled up instead of requested. Tianditu stops at 18.
Auto (Tianditu if a key is set)
